text_sections.label: Special Digivolution Condition
text_sections.text: [Digivolve] Lv.5 w/[Blue Flare]/[Xros Heart] trait: Cost 3

text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text: ＜Reboot＞ ＜Blocker＞ [On Play] [When Digivolving] Delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with the fewest digivolution cards. [All Turns] When this Digimon would leave the battle area other than by DigiXros, you may play 1 level 5 or lower [Blue Flare] or [Xros Heart] trait Digimon card from its digivolution cards without paying the cost. (Rule) Trait: Has [Xros Heart].

text_sections.label: Inherited Effect
text_sections.text: [All Turns] For each color in this [Blue Flare] or [Xros Heart] trait Digimon's digivolution cards, it gets +1000 DP.
